DEFINE FacTar ::= LIST fk, tar FROM Facility has FacilityFackey fk AND ALSO THE AVERAGE v IN (Treatmentoutcome [has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid: !fk] has TreatmentoutcomeTxadh t AND ALSO if(t = 'High' OR t = 'Medium', 1, 0) AS v) AS tar
DEFINE FacPsm ::= LIST fk, psm FROM Facility has FacilityFackey fk AND ALSO THE SUM OF c IN Treatmentbasic [has Encounter has EncounterFacid: !fk] has TreatmentbasicCrisisint c AS sc AND ALSO THE SUM OF m IN Encounter [has EncounterFacid: !fk] has EncounterMissappt m AS sm AND ALSO THE COUNT OF Encounter [has EncounterFacid: !fk] AS np AND ALSO 1 / (1 + sc / np + sm / np) AS psm
LIST k, rt, rp, q FROM Facility has FacilityFackey k
  AND ALSO k has FacTar FacTarTar a
  AND ALSO k has FacPsm FacPsmPsm p
  AND ALSO round(a, 2) AS rt
  AND ALSO round(p, 2) AS rp
  AND ALSO if(a >= THE MEDIAN v IN FacilityFackey has FacTar FacTarTar v, if(p >= THE MEDIAN w IN FacilityFackey has FacPsm FacPsmPsm w, 'High Adherence, High Stability', 'High Adherence, Low Stability'), if(p >= THE MEDIAN w2 IN FacilityFackey has FacPsm FacPsmPsm w2, 'Low Adherence, High Stability', 'Low Adherence, Low Stability')) AS q
  ORDERED WITH q ASCENDING, k ASCENDING THE FIRST 100

LIST pk, ak, tm, rt, lvl FROM Encounter has Patient p
  AND ALSO p has PatientPatkey pk
  AND ALSO has EncounterTimeMark tm
  AND ALSO has Assessmentbasic ab
  AND ALSO ab has AssessmentbasicAbkey ak
  AND ALSO ab has AssessmentbasicSuicrisk sr
  AND ALSO ab has AssessmentbasicDepressionPhq9Score ph
  AND ALSO ab has AssessmentbasicAnxietyGad7Score ga
  AND ALSO has EncounterFacid f
  AND ALSO THE MAXIMUM Facility [has FacilityFackey: !f] has FacilityEnvstress AS es
  AND ALSO THE MAXIMUM Facility [has FacilityFackey: !f] has FacilityLifeimpact AS li
  AND ALSO THE AVERAGE v IN (Treatmentbasic [has Encounter has Patient: !p] has TreatmentbasicEngagement g AND ALSO if(g = 'High', 3, if(g = 'Medium', 2, if(g = 'Low', 1, 0))) AS v) AS tes
  AND ALSO round(tes, 2) AS rt
  AND ALSO if(es = 'Severe', es, li) AS lvl
  WHERE (es = 'Severe' OR li = 'Severe') AND tes < 2
    AND (sr = 'High' OR sr = 'Severe' OR ph > 15 OR ga > 15)
    AND tm = THE MAXIMUM Encounter [has Patient: !p] has EncounterTimeMark
  ORDERED WITH tm DESCENDING THE FIRST 50

LIST pk, am, sse FROM Treatmentoutcome has TreatmentoutcomeFuncimpv fi
  AND ALSO has Treatmentbasic has Encounter e
  AND ALSO e has Patient p
  AND ALSO p has PatientPatkey pk
  AND ALSO e has Assessmentbasic ab
  AND ALSO ab has AssessmentbasicRecstatus rs
  AND ALSO ab has AssessmentbasicSocsup ss
  AND ALSO ab has AssessmentbasicRelqual rq
  AND ALSO (if(ss = 'Strong', 3, if(ss = 'Moderate', 2, 1)) + if(rq = 'Good', 3, if(rq = 'Fair', 2, if(rq = 'Poor', 1, 0)))) AS sse
  AND ALSO THE AVERAGE m IN Encounter [has Patient: !p] has EncounterMissappt m AS am
  WHERE rs = 'Stable' AND (fi = 'Moderate' OR fi = 'Significant') AND (am > 2 OR sse < 3)

LIST dx, np, cif FROM Treatmentbasic has Encounter e
  AND ALSO e has Assessmentbasic has AssessmentbasicPrimdx dx
  AND ALSO has TreatmentbasicCrisisint c
  AND ALSO e has Patient has PatientPatkey pk
  AND ALSO THE SUM OF c GROUPED BY dx AS sc
  AND ALSO THE DISTINCT COUNT OF pk GROUPED BY dx AS np
  AND ALSO round(sc / np, 2) AS cif
  ORDERED WITH cif DESCENDING THE FIRST 100

LIST ck, fk, rp, r FROM Clinician cl
  AND ALSO cl has ClinicianClinkey ck
  AND ALSO cl has Facility fac
  AND ALSO fac has FacilityFackey fk
  AND ALSO fac has FacilityCommunityResources cr
  AND ALSO THE SUM OF c IN Treatmentbasic [has Encounter has Patient has Clinician: !cl] has TreatmentbasicCrisisint c AS sc
  AND ALSO THE SUM OF m IN Encounter [has Patient has Clinician: !cl] has EncounterMissappt m AS sm
  AND ALSO THE DISTINCT COUNT OF pk IN Patient [has Clinician: !cl] has PatientPatkey pk AS np
  AND ALSO 1 / (1 + sc / np + sm / np) AS ps
  AND ALSO round(ps, 2) AS rp
  AND ALSO THE RANK OF ps WITHIN fk AS r
  WHERE cr = 'Adequate' OR cr = 'Comprehensive'
  ORDERED WITH fk ASCENDING, r ASCENDING THE FIRST 100

DEFINE TbPrev ::= LIST tb, pv FROM Treatmentbasic tb
   AND ALSO tb has TreatmentbasicEngagement g
   AND ALSO if(g = 'High', 3, if(g = 'Medium', 2, if(g = 'Low', 1, 0))) AS s
   AND ALSO tb has Encounter has EncounterTimeMark tm
   AND ALSO 1 AS one
   AND ALSO THE PREVIOUS s BY tm WITHIN one AS pv
LIST ch, n, ab, aa, ac FROM Treatmentbasic tb has TreatmentbasicChanges ch
   AND ALSO tb has TreatmentbasicEngagement g
   AND ALSO if(g = 'High', 3, if(g = 'Medium', 2, if(g = 'Low', 1, 0))) AS s
   AND ALSO tb has TbPrev TbPrevPv pv
   AND ALSO (s - pv) AS d
   AND ALSO THE COUNT OF tb GROUPED BY ch AS n
   AND ALSO THE AVERAGE pv GROUPED BY ch AS apv
   AND ALSO THE AVERAGE s GROUPED BY ch AS acur
   AND ALSO THE AVERAGE d GROUPED BY ch AS adif
   AND ALSO round(apv, 2) AS ab
   AND ALSO round(acur, 2) AS aa
   AND ALSO round(adif, 2) AS ac
   ORDERED WITH n DESCENDING

LIST fk, rtes, rrti FROM Facility has FacilityFackey fk
  AND ALSO THE AVERAGE v IN (Treatmentbasic [has Encounter has EncounterFacid: !fk] has TreatmentbasicEngagement g AND ALSO if(g = 'High', 3, if(g = 'Medium', 2, if(g = 'Low', 1, 0))) AS v) AS tes
  AND ALSO THE AVERAGE u IN (Treatmentoutcome [has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid: !fk] has TreatmentoutcomeFuncimpv fi AND ALSO if(fi = 'Significant', 3, if(fi = 'Moderate', 2, 1)) AS u) AS afi
  AND ALSO THE AVERAGE w IN (Treatmentoutcome [has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid: !fk] has TreatmentoutcomeTxadh t AND ALSO if(t = 'High' OR t = 'Medium', 1, 0) AS w) AS tar
  AND ALSO (afi * tar) AS rti
  AND ALSO round(tes, 2) AS rtes
  AND ALSO round(rti, 2) AS rrti
  WHERE tes > 2.0 AND rti < 0.8
  ORDERED WITH fk ASCENDING THE FIRST 100

LIST fk, pfis, frai, rdd FROM Facility has FacilityFackey fk
  AND ALSO has FacilityCommunityResources cr
  AND ALSO if(cr = 'Comprehensive', 3, if(cr = 'Adequate', 2, 1)) AS frai
  AND ALSO THE AVERAGE v IN (Encounter [has EncounterFacid: !fk] has Assessmentbasic has AssessmentbasicFuncimp fi AND ALSO if(fi = 'Severe', 3, if(fi = 'Moderate', 2, 1)) AS v) AS pfis
  AND ALSO THE AVERAGE s IN (Encounter [has EncounterFacid: !fk] has Assessmentbasic has AssessmentbasicSuicrisk sr AND ALSO if(sr = 'High' OR sr = 'Severe', 1, 0) AS s) AS sf
  AND ALSO (sf * 100) AS srp
  AND ALSO (pfis - frai) AS rdd
  WHERE srp > 20
  ORDERED WITH rdd DESCENDING THE FIRST 100

LIST fk, rrdd FROM Facility has FacilityFackey fk
  AND ALSO has FacilityCommunityResources cr
  AND ALSO if(cr = 'Comprehensive', 3, if(cr = 'Adequate', 2, 1)) AS frai
  AND ALSO THE AVERAGE v IN (Encounter [has EncounterFacid: !fk] has Assessmentbasic has AssessmentbasicFuncimp fi AND ALSO if(fi = 'Severe', 3, if(fi = 'Moderate', 2, 1)) AS v) AS pfis
  AND ALSO (pfis - frai) AS rdd
  AND ALSO round(rdd, 2) AS rrdd
  AND ALSO THE AVERAGE e IN (Treatmentbasic [has Encounter has EncounterFacid: !fk] has TreatmentbasicEngagement g AND ALSO if(g = 'High', 3, if(g = 'Medium', 2, if(g = 'Low', 1, 0))) AS e) AS tes
  AND ALSO THE AVERAGE w IN (Treatmentoutcome [has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid: !fk] has TreatmentoutcomeTxadh t AND ALSO if(t = 'High' OR t = 'Medium', 1, 0) AS w) AS tar
  AND ALSO ((tes + tar * 3) / 2) AS eas
  AND ALSO THE SUM OF m IN Encounter [has EncounterFacid: !fk] has EncounterMissappt m AS sm
  AND ALSO THE COUNT OF Encounter [has EncounterFacid: !fk] AS np
  AND ALSO (sm / np) AS mar
  WHERE rdd > 1.0 AND eas < 1.5 AND mar > 2.5
  ORDERED WITH rdd DESCENDING THE FIRST 100

LIST frai, corr FROM Facility has FacilityFackey fk
  AND ALSO has FacilityCommunityResources cr
  AND ALSO if(cr = 'Comprehensive', 3, if(cr = 'Adequate', 2, 1)) AS x
  AND ALSO THE AVERAGE w IN (Treatmentoutcome [has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid: !fk] has TreatmentoutcomeTxadh t AND ALSO if(t = 'High' OR t = 'Medium', 1, 0) AS w) AS y
  AND ALSO (x * y) AS xy
  AND ALSO (x * x) AS xx
  AND ALSO (y * y) AS yy
  AND ALSO 1 AS one
  AND ALSO THE COUNT OF fk WITHIN one AS n
  AND ALSO THE SUM OF x WITHIN one AS sx
  AND ALSO THE SUM OF y WITHIN one AS sy
  AND ALSO THE SUM OF xy WITHIN one AS sxy
  AND ALSO THE SUM OF xx WITHIN one AS sxx
  AND ALSO THE SUM OF yy WITHIN one AS syy
  AND ALSO (sx / n) AS frai
  AND ALSO ((n * sxy - sx * sy) / (sqrt(n * sxx - sx * sx) * sqrt(n * syy - sy * sy))) AS corr
  THE FIRST 1
